name: ARE 6474
title: Empirical Industrial Organization
description: Empirical Industrial Organization models that use simultaneous equations, discrete choice, and/or nonlinear econometric methods to analyze conduct and performance of brands and firms in noncompetitive industries. Includes static and dynamic modeling of pricing and advertising in differentiated product oligopolies. Antitrust policy applications in the U.S. and E.U.
requirement_description: ARE 5201, ECON 5201, or equivalent. Recommended preparation: ECON 6201 or equivalent; ARE 6311, ECON 6310, or equivalent.
